g.title: indexer-sync
g.text: Indexer sync: one batch from the finalized head to the read-model
The indexer is the only writer of chain-sourced rows. It reads only what the chain can no longer retract.
Exercised on Monad testnet
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed
Source: ARCHITECTURE.md sections 6.1, 10, 11; THREAT-MODEL.md invariant 16

g.title: head
g.text: 1 Read the finalized head
RPC tag finalized: irreversible without a hard fork,
about two blocks (600 ms) behind the proposal

g.title: chk
g.text: 2 Compare the cursor hash with the chain
Kept in finalized mode as a guard against
a node serving inconsistent data

g.title: roll
g.text: Mismatch: roll back
To the newest stored block hash still canonical;
delete every row above it and re-index
Deeper than the window: stop the process

g.title: chk->roll
g.text: mismatch

g.title: logs
g.text: 3 Fetch logs in a bounded batch
eth_getLogs, default 100 blocks, the smallest public range limit
Polling, so one path handles gaps after a disconnect

g.title: chk->logs
g.text: match

g.title: roll->logs
g.text: re-index

g.title: hand
g.text: 4 Decode with registered handlers
AgentSpendPolicy: LimitsSet, CallAllowed, Spent, TradedAssetSet
EntryPoint v0.7 AccountDeployed; Kernel v3.1 permission and nonce events
Settlement asset Transfer where from or to is a followed account

g.title: follow
g.text: Follow rule
An account is followed only if it first appears in a transaction
that deployed it through the configured Kernel factory
The factory is public: the API joins against its own agent records

g.title: val
g.text: 5 Validate the batch
Logs must agree with canonical block hashes and extend the cursor;
otherwise retry, store nothing

g.title: apply
g.text: 6 Apply in one transaction
Rows, block hashes, tracked accounts, and the new cursor together
Cursor flag finalized is true only while every batch used the finalized rule

g.title: val->apply
g.text: consistent

g.title: rm
g.text: PostgreSQL read-model
Rows are decoded events; current state is projected as views,
so a rollback never leaves a stale derived row

g.title: api
g.text: API
monadeum_reader, read only

g.title: rm->api
g.text: reads

g.title: pj
g.text: Worker principal job
SELECT only, up to the finalized bound
Owner deposits minus withdrawals

g.title: rm->pj
g.text: reads

g.title: nodep
g.text: The worker never imports the indexer
A tick reads the agent record, not the read-model,
so an indexer outage only delays a principal change

g.title: conf
g.text: Alternative to step 1: confirmation depth
Explicit setting only, default 10 blocks below head
Never an automatic fallback; cursor not marked finalized

g.title: later
g.text: Handlers not yet added
Reallocation contract events (one more handler)
Identity registry and genome hash commitments
